texts.setting.drawingscale.about: How many times the Model 3's own 496x384 the picture is drawn: at 2x it is 992x768, with sharper 3D. The core draws on the processor, so each step up is slower (2x draws four times the pixels). It changes the picture only.
texts.setting.idleskip.about: When the game's processor waits in a loop for something to happen, Supermodel skips ahead instead of running every pass of the loop, as upstream does by default. It makes the core faster. The game is meant to come out the same either way, but the processor spends its time differently. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.setting.starttime.about: The date and time the Model 3's real-time clock shows when the machine is switched on, in UTC; it then runs with the frames (57.524 a second, as the hardware's). The default is the first of January 2000. This is a setting, and not your computer's clock, so that a movie plays back the same on any day. It is part of the machine, so a movie needs the same value.
texts.slot.game.help: The game's ROM set: the .zip named as Supermodel and MAME name it (for example vf3.zip, scud.zip or srally2.zip). Supermodel knows a game's files by their contents, so the names of the files inside do not matter.
texts.slot.parent.help: Only for a clone (a version of a game whose set holds only the files that differ, such as vf3a.zip): the zip of the set it is a version of (vf3.zip for vf3a.zip). A game that is not a clone needs nothing here.
